title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation



Notification:

Send a daily
 summary of my job post applications

title: Lead Manager (Sales, DM Setter and Outreach)
description:
Who we are

We are a global football career and networking agency that helps footballers get to clubs abroad. We work with players across 85+ countries and a network of 2,000+ clubs, coaches, and scouts. Our team is run by active and former professional footballers. We're growing every few months and we need someone to make sure no good lead slips through the cracks.



The job, in one line

Every player who shows interest and gets stuck before our strategy call, you get them moving. If they're a fit, they end up on a call. If they're not, they get a clean no.



What you'll own

* Instagram DMs our automation can't handle: real questions, stalled conversations, players who said they're ready and went quiet

* WhatsApp follow-ups our AI passes to you: parents, money questions, anything that needs a human

* Chasing players who applied but didn't finish their Scouting Profile or didn't book

* Reactivating players who told us "not yet" when their time comes

* Instagram cold outreach to players, within strict daily limits and rules we'll train you on

* An hour or two a week helping players and parents on Reddit (helping, not selling)

* Outreach to academies, coaches, and trainers who could send us players, using AI-scraped lists, then booking them a call with our founder and looking after them once they're partners

* Keeping every lead's status, notes, and next step up to date in GoHighLevel

* One short report every day: what moved, what didn't, and why



What you'll be judged on

* Strategy calls that actually happen with players who are a fit, and partner calls booked. Not messages sent. Not hours online. Results.



You're the person we want if:

* You're hungry. You want more responsibility and more money, and you'll prove you deserve both. This role has a clear path to running our whole lead and acquisition team.

* You're proactive. You spot what's broken and come to us with a fix, not a question.

* You use AI every day, properly. ChatGPT or Claude to draft, research, and think—not just to rewrite
s. You'll work alongside Manychat, our WhatsApp AI, and a lead scraper, so you need to manage tools, not fear them.

* You know GoHighLevel, or another CRM well enough to learn it in days.

* Your written English is excellent. This job is mostly text, and players and parents notice sloppy messages.

* You follow rules exactly. Our Instagram account has limits we can't break.

* You can get someone moving without being pushy. You understand why people stall and how to get them unstuck.



Bonus points

* You understand football or have played it

* You've done appointment setting, DM setting, or lead management before

* You've done B2B outreach



What you get

* PHP 30,000 to 32,000 base, plus performance bonuses

* Direct training from the founder

* A clear path to Head of Acquisition if you perform

* A team that moves fast and rewards people who take ownership



Shift

* Set around when our leads come in, mainly US and European evenings. Confirmed with you before any offer.



How to apply

Read this carefully, because how you apply is the first test.

1. Start your application with the words "Final whistle" so we know you read to the end.

2. In under 150 words, tell us about something you improved at work without being asked. What was broken, what you did, what changed.

3. Give us one specific example of how you've used AI to get a better result in your work. Name the tool and what you did with it.

4. Write the exact DM you'd send to this player: "He filled in our application yesterday, said he wants to move in the January window, then never opened our WhatsApp message."



Applications that skip any step won't be entertained.

title: Google Workspace Administrator | Systems & Workflow Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Google Workspace Administrator to help set up, organize, and manage Google Workspace as the company's central operating system.



You will be responsible for configuring Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Meet, organizing shared drives and user permissions, and creating structured workflows that help the team work more efficiently.



This role goes beyond basic Google Workspace usage. We need someone who has hands-on experience setting up and managing business systems, documenting processes, and connecting tools to improve daily operations.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically capable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of systems setup and ongoing administration.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Set up and configure Google Workspace as the company's central business hub.

- Manage Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Meet.

- Organize shared drives, folders, file structures, and access permissions.

- Create and manage user accounts, groups, and appropriate access levels.

- Establish consistent naming conventions and document organization standards.

- Build and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and internal documentation.

- Develop and improve workflows to streamline daily business operations.

- Connect and coordinate Google Workspace with other business tools and systems.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and better system organization.

- Provide ongoing Google Workspace administration and troubleshooting.

- Train team members on processes, tools, and proper system usage.

- Maintain organized, secure, and accessible company information.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Hands-on experience setting up and administering Google Workspace for a business or organization.

- Strong knowledge of Google Drive, shared drives, folder structures, and access permissions.

- Proficiency in Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

- Experience managing user accounts and organizing company information.

- Ability to create clear SOPs, process documentation, and workflow instructions.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues, and take ownership of assigned projects.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience managing Google Workspace as a company's central operating system.

- Knowledge of Google Apps Script or other workflow automation tools.

- Experience integrating Google Workspace with third-party applications.

- Familiarity with Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.

- Experience training employees and implementing new internal systems.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who understands how to build and maintain organized business systems, not simply someone who knows how to use Google applications.



You should be able to take a disorganized workspace, create a logical structure, establish proper permissions, document processes, and make it easier for an entire team to operate efficiently.



We value initiative, problem-solving, accountability, and the ability to recommend practical improvements.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. Have you personally set up and administered Google Workspace for a company or organization? Briefly describe what you configured and managed.

2. What is your experience organizing Google Shared Drives, managing user permissions, and creating SOPs or business workflows?

3. Have you worked with automation or integration tools such as Google Apps Script, Zapier, or Make? Please describe how you have used them.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



To confirm that you have read the entire job description, please use this exact subject line when applying:



GOOGLE WORKSPACE - [YOUR FULL NAME]



Applications that do not follow the subject-line instruction may not be prioritized.

I'm looking for someone who combines creativity, digital marketing, technical skills and business organisation. Someone who enjoys variety, problem-solving and learning new things.



I want you to become a fresh set of eyes within my businesses. If you see an opportunity to improve something, I want to hear about it. If you have an exciting content idea, bring it to me. If you discover a better way of doing something, let's explore it.

- Identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring tasks.

REQUIRED SKILLS

- Experience creating and scheduling social media content.

 marketing platforms and automations.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and digital marketing funnels.

- Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

- Confidence using AI tools to support productivity, research and creativity, while maintaining originality and accuracy.

- Ability to learn new software and systems independently.

WHO YOU ARE:



You are someone who:



- Is naturally creative, curious and resourceful.

- Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Can recognise opportunities for improvement.

- Has a strong eye for design, branding and detail.

- Can adapt between two very different brand personalities.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: AI Video Creator for Meta Ads – Ecommerce Brand
description:
Do you create AI videos combining tools like Google Flow, Nano Banana, Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield and ChatGPT? Prove it.



We’re an ecommerce brand selling to Spanish-speaking customers, doing $500K+ per month in revenue and spending €200K+ per month on Meta ads. All our ads are in Spanish. AI video ads are working really well for us right now: realistic scenes that look like live action, animations, characters, viral-style content. Ads that feel like content, not like ads.



We need someone who can create them and help us scale.



We don’t hire based on CVs. We hire based on work. So instead of a long application, we want to see what you can do.



The test:

In this Google Drive folder you’ll find everything you need: the instructions and script, the reference video and our product 👉 



Create the videos following the instructions and send them to us within 24 hours. You don’t need to speak Spanish: the script comes with an English translation. But you need to be careful with Spanish text, captions and audio.



What you’ll do if you get the job:



Create AI video ads from our scripts and references

Keep characters, locations and style consistent across every scene

Build and improve workflows so you can produce volume without losing quality

Iterate fast on winning videos based on performance data

Work directly with the founder and the creative strategist



What we’re looking for:



Real experience creating videos with AI

Strong skills combining AI tools across the whole workflow:

Image: Nano Banana, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Freepik, Krea

Video: Google Flow (Veo), Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, Hailuo, Sora

Voice and lip sync: ElevenLabs, Hedra

Music: Suno

Editing and upscaling: CapCut, Premiere Pro, Topaz

You can keep the same character consistent across every scene

You already have workflows to produce at volume

You stay up to date with new AI tools and trends

You’re smart and independent. You show up with solutions, not just problems

Good English for communication



What’s in it for you:



100% remote. Work from wherever you think best

Good base salary + performance bonuses when your videos win

Full ownership of production. Nobody micromanaging how you do your work

Direct access to the founder. No pointless meetings

From brief to live test in less than 7 days. Your work doesn’t get stuck in endless revisions

See how a DTC brand really operates and scales: media buying, funnels, offers

Access to top creative and ecommerce courses paid by the company



We’re not looking for a contractor. We’re looking for someone who wants to be part of what we’re building.



How to apply:



Open the Drive folder and read the instructions

Create the videos following the script, the reference and our product

Upload your videos to your own Google Drive (set to “Anyone with the link can view”)

Send us a message here on OnlineJobs.ph starting with the words “AI CREATOR”. Include the link to your videos, the AI tools you used and your expected monthly salary in USD



Applications without the test won’t be reviewed.



We watch every video.

title: B2B Sales Closer – Digital Agency
description:
About the Role



You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, from initial discovery and understanding client requirements through to proposal presentation, negotiation and closing.



You will work alongside our dedicated Sales Development Representative, who will assist with lead generation, cold calling and appointment setting.



However, you will also be expected to proactively generate your own sales opportunities, manage inbound enquiries and conduct outbound sales activities.



This is a hands-on, target-driven sales closing role. We are not looking for someone who only books appointments or passes opportunities to another salesperson.



Our Services



AI solutions and AI agents

Business process and workflow automation

CRM and business system integrations

Custom software and application development

Website design and development

Shopify and eCommerce solutions

Digital marketing and paid advertising

SEO and AI search optimisation

SaaS and technology solutions

Digital transformation and business growth solutions



Key Responsibilities



Manage and convert inbound and outbound sales opportunities.

Conduct discovery calls and online meetings with potential clients.

Understand business challenges, requirements and objectives.

Identify opportunities across AI, automation, technology and digital services.

Recommend suitable solutions based on client needs.

Present our services and explain their business benefits.

Conduct sales presentations and product demonstrations.

Prepare, present and follow up on sales proposals and quotations.

Handle objections, negotiate and close deals.

Take ownership of sales opportunities until agreements are signed and initial payments are received.

Proactively generate new business through cold calling,
, LinkedIn and networking.

Work closely with our Sales Development Representative to improve lead quality and sales conversion.

Collaborate with our technical team on complex client requirements.

Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities with existing clients.

Maintain accurate CRM records, sales pipelines and revenue forecasts.

Achieve agreed monthly sales and revenue targets.

Continuously improve our sales processes, scripts and strategies.



Requirements



Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sales closing.

Proven track record of personally closing sales and achieving revenue targets.

Experience selling technology, software, SaaS, IT, AI, automation or digital services is highly preferred.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

Confident in speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers.

Strong consultative selling and business problem-solving skills.

Ability to understand technology solutions and explain them in simple business terms.

Strong objection-handling, follow-up and closing skills.

Comfortable generating your own leads when required.

Experience using CRM and sales management tools.

Commercially minded, self-motivated and focused on revenue growth.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of sales results.

Reliable internet connection and professional home office setup.

Available to work Australian business hours, including seasonal daylight saving adjustments.

Previous experience selling to Australian, US or UK businesses will be highly regarded.

You do not need to be a technical expert or developer. However, you must be comfortable learning about new technologies and identifying how our solutions can benefit businesses.



What We Offer

Competitive base salary.

Uncapped sales commission.

Additional performance-based bonuses.

Dedicated lead generation and appointment-setting support.

Training across our services, products and technology solutions.

Support from experienced technical, development and service delivery teams.

Access to CRM, sales tools and marketing resources.

Long-term career opportunity.

Potential to grow into a senior sales or sales management position.



How to Apply



Please provide:

Your updated CV.

Details of your previous B2B sales and closing experience.

The services, products and solutions you have previously sold.

Your average monthly sales targets and actual sales achievements.

Your average deal value and the largest deal you have personally closed.

Details of your experience selling to international businesses.

Your expected monthly base salary in PHP.

Confirmation that you can work Australian business hours.

A short 1–2 minute voice or video introduction in English.

title: Accounting General Manager
description:

We’re looking for a General Manager to run the practice day to day, support our team and help us bring in new clients. What you’ll bring



- 5+ years in an Australian accounting practice, including experience in a supervisory or management role

Tertiary accounting or commerce qualification, and a CPA 

- A track record of winning or growing client relationships, ideally in hospitality or a related sector

- Hands-on experience with Xero, Xero Practice Manager and the ATO portal

- Willingness to learn new software as our systems evolve

- Ability to take direction from the Principals, work independently and be a team player

Bonus points

- Experience with MYOB or other practice software

- Knowledge of the Hospitality Industry (General) Award



How to apply



Send us your resume and a short cover letter. Applicants are asked to not contact our office to ask for an update. We will make contact with shortlisted candidates.

title: Bookkeeper - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re in our clients’ files every day, so their books are always current and they can make decisions on real numbers. Bookkeeping is the backbone of everything we do.



We’re looking for a Bookkeeper to look after the day-to-day books for a portfolio of hospitality clients. You’ll keep files reconciled and up to date, run payroll, prepare BAS/IAS for review, and be a friendly, reliable point of contact for clients’ questions. You’ll work alongside our accountants and report to the Director.



What you’ll do

▪ Reconcile bank, credit card and clearing accounts in Xero daily, keeping client files current

▪ Process supplier bills, receipts and sales data, including POS and delivery platform reconciliations

▪ Run weekly and fortnightly payroll, including STP, super and leave, with award-based wages

▪ Prepare BAS/IAS and payroll reconciliations for accountant review

▪ Keep client queries organised and send them out on a regular weekly cycle

▪ Help clean up and catch up files for new clients

▪ Flag anything unusual in the numbers to the accounting team early



What you’ll bring

▪ 5 years’ bookkeeping experience, ideally in an accounting practice

▪ Strong Xero skills, including bank feeds, reconciliations and payroll

▪ Working knowledge of GST, BAS and payroll compliance (STP, super, PAYG withholding)

▪ Great attention to detail and the ability to manage several client files at once

▪ Clear, friendly communication with business owners

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation (e.g. Hospitality Industry General Award), POS and rostering integrations, e.g. Square, Lightspeed, Deputy.

title: Accountant - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re not a lodgement factory. We work in our clients’ files every day, keep their books current, and give them advice they can actually act on. We’d rather have fewer clients we know well than hundreds we barely talk to.



We’re looking for an Accountant to take ownership of a portfolio of hospitality clients, lead compliance across all entity types, and be the person clients trust when they need a straight answer. You’ll work closely with the Director, review the work of our bookkeeping and accounting team, and help shape how we deliver advisory as the firm grows.



What you’ll do

▪ Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships

▪ Review BAS/IAS and oversee payroll compliance, including STP, super and award-based wages

▪ Manage your own client portfolio – be their main point of contact and keep work moving to deadline

▪ Review and coach the work of bookkeepers and junior accountants, and help build our review processes

▪ Deliver practical advisory: cash flow forecasts, budgets, wage and cost-of-goods analysis, restructures and business purchases

▪ Deal with the ATO on clients’ behalf, including payment plans, objections and queries

▪ Help onboard new clients and scope engagements with the Director



What you’ll bring

▪ CA or CPA qualified (or well progressed towards it)

▪ 5 years’ experience in an Australian practice

▪ Solid working knowledge of tax and compliance across all entity types

▪ Strong Xero skills plus experience with XPM, Dext, Deputy and FoundU

▪ Confidence talking to business owners in plain English and managing your own workload

▪ Experience reviewing others’ work and giving useful feedback

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation, POS integrations, and a registered tax agent pathway



Answer these three questions to be considered:

1. What is your process on compiling EOFY Workpaper?

2. How many years of experience do you have in Australian taxation?

3. Do you also have experience in doing bookkeeping tasks?

title: YouTube Video Editor for Established Hip-Hop News Channel (128K Subscribers)
description:
ABOUT THE CHANNEL

We run an established hip-hop news and commentary brand with over 128K YouTube subscribers and around 1 million followers across all platforms. You won't be growing a channel from zero. The audience is already there. Our style is fast, opinionated storytelling, similar to DJ Akademiks and Poetik Flakko, using voiceovers, filler clips and context visuals.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Edit 7 longform commentary videos per week (8 to 15 minutes each) so the channel uploads every day. You get 1 day off each week, so one workday you will edit 2 videos. We start with fewer videos during training and build up to this.

• I provide the script and voiceover. You build the video around it with filler clips, context visuals and clean pacing

• Make 1 to 2 YouTube Shorts from each video

• Design 2 thumbnail options (A and B) per video for thumbnail testing

• Use clips and images from our shared Google Drive and log what you use

• Clean up audio: remove background music from clips, mute profanity, remove dead air

• Deliver finished work overnight (EST) so it's ready for my morning review

• Join a 30 minute weekly check in call



You will NOT handle titles, descriptions or uploading. Full training, a written SOP and thumbnail examples are provided.



COMMUNICATION IS KEY

Speed and quality matter on this channel, but I'm always willing to work with you. If you run into any issues, whether it's a tough edit, a deadline problem or something you don't understand, let me know early and we'll figure it out together. Clear communication is the most important part of this job.



GROWTH

Over time, the right editor may also take on story research and script writing, with more hours and pay to match.



PAY

Hourly, based on your rate. Hours are tracked with TimeProof or similar.

Starting pay is not the cap. My goal is to pay you well and keep raising your pay as the channel grows. You get a $1/hour raise once the channel is monetized, with more raises as we keep growing together.



BONUSES (on top of your hourly pay)

Upload milestones (one time each):

• $10 at 5 videos

• $25 at 20 videos

• $50 at 50 videos

• $100 at 100 videos



Monetization (one time):

• $100 when the channel gets monetized



View bonuses (paid every time ANY video you edit reaches these):

• $5 when a video reaches 25K views

• $10 when a video reaches 50K views

• $25 when a video reaches 100K views

Every video is a new chance to earn. The more videos that perform, the more you make.



REQUIREMENTS

• Experience editing YouTube commentary or news videos

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop, Canva or similar)

• Able to edit vertical short form content (YouTube Shorts / Reels)

• Reliable internet and consistent availability

• Follows a written SOP exactly and flags issues early



PREFERRED

• Story research skills

• Script writing experience

• Familiarity with hip-hop news and culture



ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY

Sending fake traffic of any kind to any of our videos or posts (bots, bought views, likes, comments or subscribers, engagement groups, or any other artificial boost) will result in immediate termination.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word ELEVENLABS

2. Your hourly rate and how many hours a day you're available

3. Your editing and thumbnail software

4. Answer: What is the biggest mistake editors make on commentary videos?

5. Samples: 2 YouTube videos you edited, 1 Short, and 2 thumbnails you designed



Applications missing ELEVENLABS or samples won't be reviewed. Top candidates get a short paid test, then a paid trial week.

title: Content Creator and Video Editor (Reels, Trends, YouTube)
description:
You spot the trend on Monday. By Wednesday, it's live across multiple brands.



If that sounds like a normal week to you, keep reading. If it sounds like a nightmare, this isn't your role, and that's okay.



Who we are

We're Aureus Growth Partners. We help Australian business owners build marketing that actually brings in leads: ads, funnels, content and AI, done properly. We work with a broad range of businesses, and every one of them needs video that stops the scroll.



What you'll own

• Client video. Video content and ads for our done-for-you clients, fast and on brand.

• Our brands. Short-form for our founder Chantal, our Growth Engine program, Chantal's other brands and our content clients, including posting to their social accounts and reading the reports to see what's working.

• Podcast and YouTube. Editing podcast graphics and managing our YouTube accounts.

• The ideas. Every week you bring trend-based concepts, not just edits. We want your opinion on what will work.

• AI workflows. AI isn't a nice-to-have here, it's how we work. You'll edit with AI tools like Descript and CapCut, use ChatGPT and Claude Code every day, and you'll be the one telling us about the next tool before we've heard of it.



How we'll measure you

• Client videos delivered within 72 hours, unless flagged urgent.

• 30 short-form pieces a week (mostly quick edits) published on schedule, with reach and enquiries growing every quarter.

• Your ideas getting approved and produced.

• Your edit time dropping as your AI workflows get sharper.

• Zero wrong-brand or wrong-account posts, ever.



You're our person if you

• Are genuinely an AI wizard with video. You already create and edit with AI tools every day (CapCut and Descript a plus), and you must know ChatGPT and Claude Code.

• Live on Reels, TikTok and Shorts and know what's trending before it peaks, and you follow AI video news the same way.

• Can juggle multiple brands and accounts and never mix up a logo, font or caption.

• Work fast without getting sloppy, and own your mistakes.

• Speak up the same day when footage is missing or a deadline's at risk.

Excited to hear from you! Submit your application here:

title: AI-powered content creation and management
description:
Objective: Organize, enrich, and govern a small content set using AI assistance while applying judgment, consistency, and governance.



Brief:



You are the content operations specialist for the fictional brand GreenNest (eco-friendly home essentials). You receive the following raw items (treat these as the entire source material):



1.  Blog draft idea: “5 Ways to Reduce Plastic in Your Kitchen” — 180 words of rough notes with one factual error (claims a specific filter removes 99.9 % of microplastics).



2.  Product description fragment for the PuraFlow bottle.



3.  Three social media post ideas (one is too salesy and off-brand; brand voice is calm, practical, non-hype).



4.  Two image asset names with no alt text: “bottle_outdoor_
g” and “kitchen_setup_plastic_
g”.



5.  A short customer FAQ snippet that contradicts the blog draft on one point.





Required work:



1.  Create a simple structured content library (Notion page, Google Sheet, or clean markdown/PDF) with columns/fields for: Title, Type, Status, SEO title, Meta description, Primary tags, Alt text, Brand-voice score (your judgment 1–5), and Notes.



2.  Use AI to generate improved titles, meta descriptions (≤155 characters), social captions, and alt text. Then manually edit at least 50 % of the AI output and document what you changed and why.



3.  Produce a 7-day lightweight content calendar (one primary piece + one supporting social post per day) that resolves the contradictions and prioritizes accuracy.



4.  Flag every item that needs human review or fact-checking before publication. Propose a simple governance rule for future AI-assisted content.









•  Use only original or public-domain prompts and assets. Do not copy copyrighted styles, music, or likenesses of real people.



•  Disclose every AI tool used and the prompts. Mark AI-generated elements clearly.



•  Review and correct AI output. Do not ship raw AI results.



•  Prefer free or freemium tools (examples: CapCut, Kling AI free tier, Runway free credits, Pika, ChatGPT/Claude free, Notion, Google Sheets, Canva free).



•  Deliverables must include a short process note (tools, prompts, what you changed manually, any quality or ethics issues you spotted).

title: Video Editor (Long-Form) — Claude Code experience required
description:
Job Type: Full-Time Schedule: 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST (5:00 PM – 1:00 AM Philippine Time), Monday to Friday Starting Salary: $6/hr — negotiable upward based on the work



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a growing marketing agency looking for a video editor to join our team long-term. This is not a one-off project — we want someone looking for stable, consistent work with a team that values and invests in its people.



Your main focus will be editing long form content using Claude Code.



This is not an entry-level editing position, and it's not a pure editing position either. We run our production pipeline with Claude Code, and you need to be able to work in it. If you've never opened a terminal, this role will be painful for you.



DO NOT APPLY IF YOUR EXPERIENCE IS WITH CAPCUT, BEGINNER LEVEL APPS, OR ONE-CLICK EDITORS. ONCE AGAIN, THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER LEVEL POSITION.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Editing 3 long-form videos per week from raw footage, scripts, or briefs

Adding motion graphics, animated captions, transitions, and sound design that match current short-form trends

Using Claude Code to automate the repetitive parts of your workflow — batch processing, file organization, ffmpeg jobs, transcript and caption pipelines, render prep, anything you'd otherwise do by hand 40 times a week

Using AI tools to speed up and enhance the creative side (AI captioning, voice tools, generative assets, upscaling)

Collaborating with our team during your shift for feedback and revisions

Occasionally helping with long-form projects (YouTube videos, webinars, client content)

REQUIREMENTS

Claude Code experience. Not "I've used ChatGPT." You've actually run Claude Code, given it a task, read what it produced, and fixed it when it was wrong. Tell us what you've built or automated with it.

Comfortable in a terminal and with basic scripting. You don't need to be a developer. You do need to not be scared of a command line, ffmpeg, or a Python script Claude Code writes for you.

Real editing software. Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Timeline editing, keyframes, masking, audio work.

Proven short-form experience — you understand hooks, pacing, retention editing, and platform-specific best practices.

Strong motion graphics skills (After Effects, Premiere with MOGRTs, or similar).

Able to work 5 AM – 1 PM EST consistently, Monday to Friday

Reliable internet and a computer that can actually handle video editing

Strong communication — responsive during work hours, proactive about asking questions

Looking for a long-term, stable position, not freelance side work

WHO THIS ISN'T FOR



Being direct so nobody wastes their time:



Entry-level editors. We don't have the bandwidth to teach editing fundamentals.

CapCut-only editors. If your workflow is CapCut templates, auto-captions, and one-tap mobile editing apps, you're below the bar for this role. CapCut Pro as one tool in a larger kit is fine. CapCut as the whole kit isn't.

Editors who won't touch technical tools. Half the value here is automating the boring 60% of the job. If that sounds like someone else's problem, it's not a fit.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

Long-form editing experience (YouTube videos, podcasts, documentaries, course content) — this is a real plus, we'd rather hire someone who can carry a 20-minute video than someone who's only ever cut 30 seconds

Experience editing for marketing agencies or multiple client brands

Content repurposing experience (turning long-form into short-form clips)

Any automation, scripting, or pipeline-building you've done around video

WHY WORK WITH US

Long-term stability — we're hiring someone to grow with us, not a temporary gig

Consistent workload and predictable hours

A team that respects your time and skill

You'll get significantly better at AI-assisted production, because you'll be using it every day

HOW TO APPLY



To make sure you've read this posting carefully, start your application with the word "ARUGULA" and include:



A link to your portfolio or 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio site)

Your Claude Code experience — what you've used it for, what you built or automated, and what went wrong the first time. Screenshots or a repo are welcome.

Which editing software and AI tools you use day to day

Confirmation that you can work 5 AM – 1 PM EST

(Optional) Examples of long-form videos you've edited



Applications without the keyword, portfolio links, or a real answer on Claude Code will not be considered.



We're excited to see your work.

title: Industrial/Product Designer - Medical & Health Products
description:
We're an Australian health and performance company that designs and sells our own physical products. We're looking for a talented industrial designer to help us take new product ideas from concept to manufacturable design. The next project is a TMJ (jaw) product, with more products to follow for the right person.



This isn't just a drafting role. We want someone who can think through the design problem with us, which means working out how to make a design actually work, what materials to use, and how it will be manufactured.



What you'll do:



* Turn concepts, sketches and briefs into detailed 3D models

* Produce production-ready CAD and design files (STEP, STL, and 2D technical drawings)

* Help solve design problems: fit, function, comfort, durability and ease of use

* Recommend materials (plastics, silicones, medical-grade materials, etc.) and manufacturing methods (injection moulding, 3D printing, etc.)

* Create renders and prototype-ready files for 3D printing and sampling

* Iterate on designs based on testing and feedback

* Prepare files for manufacturers and help answer their technical questions



What we're looking for:



* Proven experience in industrial or product design, with a portfolio of physical products

* Strong skills in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Rhino or similar

* Good knowledge of materials and design for manufacture

* Experience with medical, wearable, dental or health products is a big plus

* Clear written English and good communication on video calls

* A problem solver who takes initiative and suggests better ways to do things



Confidentiality (important);

All of our product designs are strictly confidential. You'll be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement and an IP assignment agreement before seeing any project details. All designs, files and ideas created belong to our company. You must not share, reuse or show any work in your portfolio without written permission.



To apply:

Send your portfolio (examples of physical products you've designed, ideally with CAD files or renders), the software you use, your experience with materials and manufacturing, and your availability and expected rate. Please start your application with the word "TMJ" so we know you've read this.

title: Creative Marketing & Virtual Assistant Contractor
description:
Hi! I'm Yas, of HIDARI Group, a growing Canadian business optimization and implementation company.

HIDARI works with service-based business owners who need help improving their operations, systems, marketing, digital presence and growth. We don't stop at giving clients a strategy. We help turn that strategy into something that actually works in their business.



As we grow, I'm looking for a few talented part-time contractors to join our Creative Marketing & Virtual Assistant team.



The Kind of Person I'm Looking For:



This role is for someone who likes to create, think, organize and solve problems.

I'm not looking for someone who waits for instructions and checks tasks off a list.

I'm looking for someone who sees an opportunity and says:

"I have an idea. What if we tried this?"

The work we create together should help generate real clients and real revenue.



Your Core Responsibilities

This is where you'll spend most of your time:



- Creating Instagram and LinkedIn content

- Designing Canva graphics and carousels

- Writing engaging captions in excellent English

- Editing short-form videos and Reels

- Scheduling and managing social media posts

- Planning and maintaining a monthly content calendar



As You Grow

As HIDARI and our client base grow, the right person can take on more, depending on their strengths and interests:



- Lead magnets, guides and downloadable resources

- Mailchimp
 campaigns

- Website updates (WordPress)

- Mini-courses and digital products

- Eventbrite and event promotion

- Competitor, industry and marketing research

- Funnel building and marketing automation

- Improving our internal systems and processes



You don't need experience in these areas to apply. I'm much more interested in strong core skills, initiative and a willingness to learn.



You'll Probably Fit In Well If You Are:

- Fluent in written English

- Confident with Canva

- Familiar with Instagram and LinkedIn

- Comfortable editing short-form video (CapCut or similar)

- Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve your work

- Organized, dependable and detail-oriented

- Proactive and able to work independently

- Open to feedback and revisions

- Willing to research and figure things out when you don't know the answer



Bonus: Experience with Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, WordPress or Eventbrite.



What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

- You're self-directed. You manage your own workload and don't wait to be told what to do next.

- You bring ideas to the table. You regularly pitch new content ideas, formats or improvements without being asked.

- Our content calendar runs ahead. Content is planned and scheduled at least 2 weeks in advance.

- We post consistently. Instagram and LinkedIn stay active every week, with no gaps.

- Your work is on-brand from the first draft. You learn our brand guidelines and voice, so revisions get lighter over time.

- You meet deadlines without reminders. Flexible hours only work when deliverables arrive on time.

- You learn from the numbers. You notice which posts perform best and suggest how we can do more of what works.



How to Apply

To make sure you've read the entire posting, please begin your application with the words "Blue Cat." Applications without it will not be considered.



Please send me:

- A brief introduction about yourself

- Your resume

- Your portfolio or examples of your work



Links to social media accounts you've helped manage

Your weekly availability



Creative Exercise



I'm more interested in how you think than in something perfectly polished. Please review HIDARI Group and send me:

1. Instagram Carousel Idea: Share one carousel concept. A simple written outline is completely fine.

2. Growth Idea: Give me one marketing idea you think HIDARI should try and briefly explain why you think it would work.

Please don't spend hours on this. I'm looking for creativity, initiative and how you approach marketing problems.



Our Hiring Process



Application. Send your application and creative exercise.

Short call. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a 15–20 minute video call.

Paid trial. Finalists complete a short, paid trial task based on real HIDARI work.

Offer. The best fit receives a contractor offer and onboarding.



What It's Like Working With Me



I move quickly, I have a lot of ideas, and I enjoy working with people who are comfortable contributing their own.

See something we could improve? Tell me.

 Have an idea? Pitch it.

 

Something isn't working? Help me understand why and figure out a better approach.



I want to build a team of talented people who enjoy producing great work together. As HIDARI grows, I want the people who helped build it to have opportunities to grow with it.

If that sounds like an environment you'd enjoy, I'd love to hear from you.



Start your application with "Blue Cat" and tell me what you can bring to HIDARI.

title: Real Estate Listing Officer / Customer Service

The Property Listing Officer is responsible for securing, documenting, verifying, managing, marketing, and optimizing all property listings (individual & corporate).

- Provide recommendations for pricing adjustments and lead follow-ups.

- Maintain weekly listing inventory and performance reports.

- Answer the client's inquiries regarding a property and assign it to the agent

- Perform any listing-related tasks as directed by management.

- Carry out additional duties as required by business priorities and operational needs.

- Assist in process improvements to streamline listing management, marketing, and lead generation.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- 100% of listings posted with signed MA

- Photoshoot scheduling turnaround time

- Calls answered within 5 minutes and have provided accurate info

- Accountability, integrity, and flexibility

You will manage daily guest interactions, dynamic pricing, turnover coordination, maintenance scheduling, vendor management, and listing optimization for multiple properties.

- Highly reliable, trustworthy, and consistent.

Experience with:

- Background in hospitality, customer service, or operations management.

- Experience in calendar syncing and listing optimization.



Character Traits We Value:

title: Finance Analyst (Accounting & Financial Operations)
description:
About the Role

Pawkit is a growing Singapore-based pet technology company. We are looking for a commercially minded, analytical and tech-savvy finance professional to take ownership of our accounting, financial operations and business performance analysis.

This is not a traditional accounting role. Beyond maintaining accurate accounts, we want someone who understands the business behind the numbers, challenges inefficient processes and leverages technology and AI to build smarter, more scalable financial systems.



Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage a full set of accounts using Xero, including month-end and year-end closing.

- Manage accounts payable, receivables, bank reconciliations, Stripe transactions, refunds and provider payouts.

- Prepare accurate financial statements and monthly management reports.

- Analyse revenue, expenses, service profitability and business performance.

- Develop budgets, financial forecasts and cash flow projections.

- Identify financial discrepancies, revenue leakages and cost-saving opportunities.

- Conduct financial modelling to support pricing and business decisions.

- Improve financial controls, workflows and automation.

- Coordinate with external accountants, auditors and tax agents on statutory compliance.



Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.

- At least 3 years of relevant accounting and financial analysis experience.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage a full set of accounts.

- Strong hands-on experience with Xero and Stripe is mandatory.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including financial modelling and data analysis.

- Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Advantageous but not mandatory:



- CPA, ACCA or equivalent professional qualifications.

- Experience with Singapore-based companies or startups.

- Experience with Zoho CRM, business intelligence tools, workflow automation or system integrations.

- Experience implementing AI-driven process improvements.



Who We Are Looking For

-A critical thinker who questions numbers, assumptions and existing processes.

- Someone who understands commercial implications beyond accounting principles.

- A resourceful individual who can independently research, learn and solve unfamiliar problems.

- Someone who naturally looks for ways to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.

- Someone who identifies what needs to be done without constantly waiting for instructions.

- An individual who is curious about technology and willing to experiment with better ways of working.



We expect you to bring financial expertise into the company. Training will be provided on our business operations and internal processes, but candidates must already be proficient in the core financial tools and responsibilities required for this role.



Application Questions



Please answer the following two questions when applying:

1. Tell us about a problem you identified at work that nobody had asked you to solve. What made you notice it, what did you do about it, and what was the outcome?



2. Imagine you have joined a growing startup where financial processes are unstructured, and the founder has limited time to guide you. What would you aim to accomplish in your first 30 days, and why?



We value specific examples, genuine experiences and independent thinking over textbook answers.

title: Revit Modeler (Structural/MEPS)
description:
Looking for a BIM Modeler with strong Autodesk Revit skills and a practical understanding of how buildings are built. You'll develop and coordinate accurate 3D models for our U.S. construction projects, catch conflicts before they reach the field, and look for smarter, lower-cost ways to build. You'll work closely with our U.S.-based project managers, superintendents and engineers.



BIM modeling

• Build and maintain detailed Revit models from architectural, structural and MEP drawings, including from scratch when needed

• Update models for design revisions, RFIs, site conditions and field changes

• Maintain the right Level of Development (LOD) and consistent BIM standards



Clash detection and coordination

• Run clash detection in Revit and Navisworks across architectural, structural and MEP systems

• Coordinate ductwork, plumbing, electrical, fire protection and structural framing

• Prepare clash reports, coordination drawings and 3D views for team review



Value engineering and constructability

• Review models for cost-saving and value engineering opportunities

• Suggest simpler layouts, better material use and more efficient installation methods without compromising design intent



Construction documentation

• Produce plans, sections, elevations, details and schedules from Revit

• Prepare shop drawings, installation layouts and coordination drawings

• Generate quantity takeoffs and material schedules for estimating and procurement



Remote construction support

• Join virtual coordination meetings with the U.S. team

• Review site photos and field measurements to check model accuracy and keep as-builts current

• Flag discrepancies between the model and site conditions, and help resolve them



WHAT YOU BRING



Required

• Strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit

• Experience building and coordinating architectural, structural or MEP models

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings

• Understanding of building systems, construction methods and assemblies

• Ability to identify clashes and develop practical solutions

• Strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to work independently



Preferred

• Background in Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture or a related field

• Experience with general contractors, engineering firms or construction teams

• Proficiency in Navisworks

• Familiarity with U.S. construction practices and building codes

• Experience with value engineering, quantity takeoffs and constructability reviews

• Familiarity with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Someone who goes beyond creating Revit models. You understand how buildings are put together, you raise coordination issues before anyone asks, and you're always looking for ways to improve systems and reduce construction costs.

title: Marketing Recruiter & Business Support
description:
Marketing Recruiter & Business Support (Digital Marketing & Creative Recruiting)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern | Fluent English required



About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.



Our biggest opportunity right now is building an exceptional marketing team. We believe that great companies are built by great people, and finding those people is one of the highest-impact jobs in the company. We are looking for someone who loves recruiting, understands digital marketing (to ask very detailed skill based questions), and gets excited about finding the people who will help TopFoxx grow for years to come.



The Role

This is not a traditional HR recruiter position, and it is not simply posting jobs and scheduling interviews. Your job is to build a world-class marketing team.



You will own the recruiting process for our marketing and creative departments, partnering directly with leadership to understand every role, identify exceptional talent, and hire people who can make a measurable impact on our business.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing well enough to recognize great marketers. You don't need to be the person running Meta Ads or creating videos yourself, but you should understand what separates an average candidate from an exceptional one.



The 80/20 Structure

This role is expected to be approximately:

- 80% Recruiting & Talent AcquisitionYour primary focus will always be finding, evaluating, and helping us hire exceptional people, particularly across marketing, creative, e-commerce, and growth roles.

- 20% Marketing, HR, Project & Business SupportWe're a lean and growing company, so when recruiting volume is lighter or another priority needs additional support, you'll have the opportunity to contribute beyond recruiting.



Depending on your strengths and current company priorities, this could include supporting marketing-related projects, research, project coordination, HR initiatives, documentation, process improvement, team engagement, administrative projects, or other cross-functional business needs.



We're looking for someone who enjoys recruiting but is also curious, adaptable, and willing to jump into new challenges when they can make an impact.



What Success Looks Like

You are successful when TopFoxx consistently hires exceptional marketing talent that helps the business grow.



Day to day, that means you:

- Build strong pipelines before hiring becomes urgent.

- Fill marketing positions quickly without sacrificing quality.

- Identify candidates who demonstrate ownership, problem-solving, communication, and execution.

- Create an excellent candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.

- Support new team members during their first month by helping them integrate into the company and successfully transition into their role.

- Help onboard team members by sharing bonus plans, setting clear KPIs, and ensuring they understand how success will be measured.

- Proactively source top talent from other companies through LinkedIn and other professional networks.

- Continuously improve our recruiting process so hiring becomes faster, more consistent, and more data-driven.

- Keep recruiting organized with accurate trackers, interview notes, scorecards, bonus plans and documentation.



What You'll Recruit For

You'll primarily recruit for marketing and creative positions, including:

- Paid Media: Meta Ads Specialists, TikTok Ads Specialists & Performance Marketing Managers

- Creative: Video Editors, Creative Strategists, Graphic Designers & UGC Creators

- Lifecycle Marketing:
 Marketing & SMS Marketing Specialists, Digital marketing specialists

- E-commerce Marketing: Growth Marketing Specialists, Shopify Marketing, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Partnerships: Affiliate Marketing Managers & Influencer Marketing ManagersSales: Wholesale Sales Representatives & E-commerce Sales Professionals



As TopFoxx grows, you'll also help recruit future marketing leadership positions.



What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)



1) Full-Cycle Recruiting

- Own the complete recruitment process from intake meeting through offer acceptance.

- Partner with hiring managers to fully understand each position before recruiting begins.

- Write compelling, high-converting job advertisements.

- Post jobs across multiple recruiting platforms.

- Source passive candidates through LinkedIn and other channels.

- Build talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

- Review resumes, portfolios, and applications.

- Conduct structured interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and leadership.

- Perform reference checks when appropriate.

- Keep candidates informed throughout the hiring process.

- Present hiring recommendations supported by structured evaluations.



2) Candidate Evaluation

- Evaluate candidates based on real ability, ownership, communication, and execution, not resumes alone.

- Review portfolios, case studies, assessments, and work samples.

- Identify high performers who align with TopFoxx's culture and expectations.

- Build structured interview scorecards for every role.

- Develop role-specific interview questions.

- Recommend assessments that accurately measure job performance.



3) Recruiting Systems & Process Improvement

- Build and improve recruiting workflows.

- Create hiring playbooks and recruiting SOPs.

- Maintain recruiting dashboards and hiring trackers.

- Improve interview processes and candidate evaluation systems.

- Keep recruiting documentation organized and up to date.

- Continuously recommend ways to improve hiring quality and efficiency.



4) Partnership With Leadership

- Meet regularly with hiring managers to understand hiring priorities.

- Help define ideal candidate profiles before recruiting begins.

- Ensure every position has clear expectations and measurable success criteria.

- Keep leadership updated on recruiting progress, hiring challenges, and pipeline health.

- Recommend improvements to job descriptions, compensation, interview processes, and recruiting strategy when appropriate.



5) Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

- Represent TopFoxx professionally throughout the hiring process.

- Write engaging candidate outreach messages.

- Ensure every candidate has a positive experience, regardless of hiring outcome.

- Help strengthen TopFoxx's reputation as an employer of choice.



6) Onboarding Support

- Assisting with onboarding, employee experience, and company culture initiatives.

- Helping coordinate cross-functional projects.

- Ensure candidates receive the information, tools, and documentation needed before their first day.

- Partner with hiring managers to help new hires transition successfully into their roles.



7) Additional Support & Cross-Functional ProjectsWhen recruiting needs are lighter, or as business needs evolve, you may also support other areas of the company based on your skills and priorities. This may include:

- Supporting project management and cross-functional projects when additional help is needed.

- Supporting other operational or organizational projects as the company grows.

- Helping coordinate marketing projects and follow-ups.

- Supporting special projects from marketing leadership or the Founder.

- Helping create or improve SOPs and internal processes.

- Supporting HR and administrative projects.

- Researching solutions to business or operational problems.

- Taking ownership of other projects where your skills can help the company move faster.



This role is primarily focused on recruiting, but as TopFoxx continues to grow, there may be opportunities to develop your skills and take on additional responsibilities in areas where you can make a meaningful impact.



What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

- 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

- Experience recruiting digital marketing, creative, e-commerce, or startup positions.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills.

- Experience managing multiple open positions simultaneously.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- Strong ownership mindset, you proactively solve problems instead of waiting for direction.

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

- Must have a growth mindset, developing your skills and solving hardest problems. 



Nice to have:

- LinkedIn Recruiter

- Indeed

- OnlineJobs.ph

- Google Workspace

- Asana

- AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude

- Startup or e-commerce experience

- Experience building recruiting scorecards, interview guides, assessments, or hiring SOPs



As a fully remote team, TopFoxx uses Time Doctor during working hours for international team members. Time Doctor is a time-tracking and productivity tool that records hours worked and takes periodic screenshots while the timer is running. For this full-time role, it is used to verify and track the expected 8-hour workday.

title: PRODUCTION MANAGER, YOUTUBE CHANNELS (Full-time, Remote)
description:
We run a portfolio of long-form true crime YouTube channels. We are hiring a Production Manager to own production end to end: from approved idea to published video, on every channel.



This is an operations and people-management role, not a creative or editing role. It is not entry level. If you have not managed a team and kept a publishing schedule before, please do not apply.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN & DO

- The output of the production team.

- The upload schedule on every channel.

- The production board (Trello): nothing stalls, everything moves, deadlines are met.

- You manage the scheduler team: their response times, QC quality and schedule accuracy.

- Follow-through with writers, editors, thumbnail designers and voice talent when work is late or missing.

- Thumbnail quality and editing quality against our standards and SOPs. Script quality sits with the senior writers; you coordinate with them.

- Monetization and policy issues on published videos: limited ads, copyright, reused content.

- Input on content direction: you discuss what to produce next with the founder and suggest ideas.

- Monitor YouTube trends, monetization risks, copyright issues, and platform changes

- Track channel health (output, views, rpm, retention)





WHO THIS IS FOR

- You have managed a team and kept a publishing or delivery schedule for them.

- You are fast, reliable and have agency. You do not need to be told twice and you do not need to be micromanaged.

- You have very high attention to detail: you notice what might stall production and fix it before it becomes a problem.

- You enjoy managing people and holding them to a standard.

- You use Trello, Asana, Jira, ClickUp or similar.

- YouTube Studio, scheduling, QC and monetization policy experience is strongly preferred.





WHAT YOU GET

- $1,000 - $1500/month (depending on experience), plus wellness allowance.

- Full-time, remote, direct access to the founder.

- Real ownership: after a 2-week trial the scheduler team reports to you, and your decision rights grow as you prove them.

- Growth: this is the senior operations seat in a company that is scaling. As the team and your responsibility grow, so do pay and bonuses.



HOURS

- Full-time, 45 hours a week. No other job or client work during your employment with us.

- Flexible hours with two anchor points: a short morning check (before 9am Philippine time) and an evening block of about 7 hours (5pm to midnight Philippine time), when the team delivers. Monday to Saturday.

- Respond to Trello and 
 within 1 hour during your evening block.

- Outside your hours, the founder can reach you on
 for an urgent issue. This is very rare.



NOT FOR YOU IF

- You want to make videos rather than run the people who make them.

- You wait to be told what to do next instead of finding it yourself.

- You have only run your own channel.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your subject line with the word TANGERINE followed by your name. Then answer all ten questions below, numbered, in order. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



1. Describe your experience managing a production or publishing team: team size, roles, who reported to you, and what you were responsible for delivering and how often.

2. Links to channels or projects you managed. For each, state exactly what you personally did.

3. How did you track whether your team's work was done and on time? Name the tool and your routine.

4. Tell us about a time a schedule slipped on your watch. What happened, and what did you change so it did not happen again?

5. Tell us about a time a problem kept happening in your team, and what action you took so it did not happen again.

6. How do you d
 that a video is an outlier for its channel, and what do you do when you spot one?

7. Describe your experience with YouTube monetization, demonetization, limited ads or copyright issues, and how you handled them.

8. What have you set up in a previous role that nobody asked you to set up? What did it fix?

9. Confirm you can work full-time with no other job, with the hours above. State your time zone.

10. Your expected monthly rate and your earliest start date.

title: Remote Property Management Assistant (English and Spanish Required)
description:
