title: Financial Accountant (AU Experience) + Morning Shift
description:
Job Brief  



We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Financial Accountant to manage end-to-end financial accounting, month-end close, transactional finance, and credit management functions. 



Operating as a seamless extension of the Australian finance team, this role goes beyond routine processing to drive accountability, maintain strict accuracy, and deliver actionable insights. The successful remote professional will take full ownership of defined workstreams, ensure compliance with Australian financial standards, and actively contribute to continuous process improvement to support business growth. 



Responsibilities 



Support the monthly financial close and assist in preparing recurring financial reports to maintain accurate financial visibility. 

Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, proactively investigating and resolving reconciling items on a timely basis. 

Prepare accurate journals, accruals, prepayments, and month-end adjustments backed by appropriate supporting documentation. 

Review general ledger activity regularly to identify, investigate, and correct unusual, incomplete, or incorrectly coded transactions. 

Maintain fixed asset records and support depreciation calculations alongside routine asset reconciliations. 

Support intercompany accounting workflows, perform balance reconciliations, and resolve outstanding intercompany accounts promptly. 

Assist with year-end audit requirements by preparing comprehensive supporting schedules and audit documentation. 

Take operational ownership of the aged receivables ledger, executing routine collection activities to support cash flow optimisation. 

Monitor customer balances, track overdue accounts, and ensure strict adherence to approved commercial payment terms. 

Issue customer statements, payment reminders, and collection correspondence while conducting proactive follow-up communications. 

Maintain clear collection notes, agreed action steps, and follow-up schedules to provide a complete and transparent audit trail. 

Investigate unapplied receipts, short payments, and account discrepancies, coordinating directly with stakeholders for resolution. 

Prepare regular aged debt, collection, and credit risk reports for Australian management review. 

Escalate material overdue accounts, disputed balances, payment-plan requests, and credit risk exceptions to Australian leadership. 

Review supplier invoices and supporting documentation to verify completeness and adherence to internal approval thresholds. 

Assist with accounts payable reconciliations, payment run preparations, and the investigation of billing discrepancies. 

Support employee expense reporting and corporate card reconciliations to ensure complete financial compliance. 

Maintain accurate customer, supplier, and financial records alongside complete supporting documentation across systems. 

Manage Groupware submissions in strict accordance with established Delegation of Authority requirements. 

Prepare recurring monthly spend reports, schedules, and ad hoc financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. 

Support actual-versus-budget analysis and investigate material variances to ensure financial transparency. 

Proactively identify unusual transactions, financial trends, control issues, or exceptions and bring them to management's attention. 

Maintain clean, accurate accounting records within Xero and other relevant company finance systems. 

Operate strictly within established approval processes, financial delegations, and internal governance controls. 

Assist with documenting finance procedures, calendars, checklists, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). 

Identify and execute opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate recurring finance activities to improve operational efficiency. 



Requirements 

Demonstrated hands-on experience in financial accounting, including month-end close procedures and balance sheet reconciliations. 

Strong capability in accounts receivable and credit management, with confidence in managing overdue accounts and customer collections. 

Experience supporting an Australian business or strong familiarity with Australian accounting principles and practices. 

High attention to detail, sound commercial judgement, and the ability to investigate root causes rather than simply processing transactions. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to liaise confidently with Australian managers and clients. 

Ability to work independently within established procedures, manage strict monthly deadlines, and proactively escalate material exceptions. 



Software Proficiency 

Xero or similar ERP/accounting platforms 

Microsoft Excel, including advanced data manipulation and reconciliations 

Groupware systems 



Education 

Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related business discipline. 

CPA / CA qualification or progress towards is highly regarded.

title: URGENT: Australian Tax Accountant
description:
**MUST BE AVAILABLE TO START ASAP WITH NO CURRENT EMPLOYMENT OR OTHER ENGAGEMENTS.**



ROLE SUMMARY:

Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS:

- CPA qualification is a requirement

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.

Xero | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)

Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your resume and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

title: Purchasing/Parts Coordinator
description:
Purpose

The Remote Purchasing/Parts Coordinator is the operational link between Waldrop's customers, internal teams, and suppliers. The Remote Purchasing/Parts Coordinator promotes customer satisfaction by treating each customer as a priority, answering incoming calls and routing them appropriately, and placing outbound calls to order parts or follow up on pending orders.



Our Core Values

• We are committed to fairness in all that we do for our customers, the company, and our team. Doing right by the customer every time means we work with integrity and compassion.

• We are committed to quality in all that we do. We do the best we can and show others that we care.

• We are committed to continuous improvement and growth. We constantly refine and improve our processes.

Dispatch and Customer Service

• Handle every customer as a priority, with empathy and patience

• Communicate parts availability to Dispatchers and Technicians for fast and seamless project scheduling

• Accuracy of data entry, including purchase orders and vendor records

• Attending and participating in training meetings (including 1-on-1s)

• Dependable attendance record



Competencies: Skills and Behaviors Required for the Job

2. Positive, upbeat attitude (social)

3. Empathetic (patience and understanding)

4. Proven track record of professionalism

5. Verbal and written communication

6. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

7. Sense of urgency

8. Can explain why Waldrop versus competitors

9. Knows and understands Waldrop

10. Understanding of Waldrop's services and trades



Top MUST Haves

1. Clear, effective, and professional communicator in English

2. Dependability

3. Must provide your own call headset, computer, and monitor to perform remote work (see hardware requirements below)



Top 3 LIKE to Haves

1. Purchasing experience

2. High drive for achievement and success

3. Customer service experience



Also valued: procurement or administrative experience, and familiarity with home trades business and/or inventory management systems.



 Hardware Requirements

• Processor: Intel Core Ultra 200 series, Intel Core Ultra 300 series, AMD Ryzen AI 300 series, or AMD Ryzen AI 400 series

• RAM: 16GB DDR5 minimum, preferably dual channel

• Storage: 256GB M.2 NVMe SSD minimum

• Operating system: Windows 11 Pro



Recommendations for Continuous Improvement

1. Feedback channels: Create regular channels for employees to provide feedback on the training process.

2. Peer training: Introduce sessions where Purchasing Coordinator can share real-world customer experiences during side-by-side observations.

3. External partnerships: Partner with external training organizations to continually improve and benchmark our training methods.

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Officer Australian Freight & Logistics
description:

The role is to manage and optimize the accounts payable / receivable process, ensuring timely invoice processing and maintaining accurate financial records in Excel, Xero and Cargowise.  Strong experience using Xero with high attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. You will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on outstanding debts, collection issues in collaboration with customers and internal teams, while developing strategies to minimize overdue accounts. 



This role is ideal for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a remote environment and values process improvement and accuracy. We are looking for someone who is reliable, disciplined, proactive, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work as part of a supportive and professional team.



Key Responsibilities:

Invoicing and Billing:

Receivables Management:

Debtor Management:

• Follow up on overdue accounts via phone,
, and written correspondence

Administrative Support:

• Maintain customer/client master data within Xero accounting system

Requirements:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in Accounts Payable / Receivable role for Australian companies – ideally in freight and logistics industry

• Minimum 1+ years experience using Xero * Essential

• Minimum 1+ years experience using Cargowise * Highly desirable

• Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint and Google suite

• Strong time management and organizational skills

• Experience with Australian GST regulations and compliance

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision or direction

• Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

• High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

• Clear communicator with a professional, team-first attitude

• Dual monitor – 2 x Screens required

• Min 8GB RAM

• Min 500GB Hard Drive

• Microsoft windows genuine version

• Fibre Internet – Minimum 100MBps & above

• Backup Internet – Second pre-paid ‘dongle’ style

Wage: PHP 35,000 – PHP 50,000 per month with government mandated benefits based on experience and skills



Benefits:

title: Medical Virtual Assistant
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her seventies with COPD. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or
 work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at 
 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type LUNGS.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we
 you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.
